functions.name: SceneExtentComputation
functions.summary: Computes the scene extent by walking the collision geometry node list once: it reads the node count via AudioNetworkNodeCount(dword_8AFE88), then for each active node (LinkedListFlagBitExtraction non-zero and the node's byte at offset 60 with bit 0x10 clear) calls BoundingBoxComputation to get a bounding box and folds its six outputs into running min (v6,v7,v8, initialized to +FLT_MAX) and max (v9,v10,v11, initialized to -FLT_MAX) accumulators. If no node produces a non-degenerate box (maxX<=minX or maxZ<=minZ on the two stored axes), it returns an error path that emits the CouldNotGetExt debug log. Otherwise it stores the normalized extents on `this`: this[585]=min0, this[587]=min2, this[586]=8.0/(max0-min0), this[588]=8.0/(max2-min2). Existing analysis labels the two stored axes X and Z (scene min extent / scale for rendering).

Fold first three bounding-box outputs into the minima: if v6 > v12 then v6 = v12; if v7 > v13 then v7 = v13; if v8 > v14 then v8 = v14.
Fold remaining three bounding-box outputs into the maxima: if v9 < v15 then v9 = v15; if v10 < v16 then v10 = v16; if v11 < v17 then v11 = v17.
